cta.text: An independent review of the project by the university's rubric: scores on 8 criteria, red flags and a week of experiments.

empty.title: The project has not been evaluated yet
empty.text: The AI reads the answers to every step of the incubator and evaluates the project the way a venture committee expert would.

items.score: a total score of 0–100 and the readiness level
items.criteria: a score and a justification for every criterion

empty.note: It is a recommendation for the team, not a decision of a competition jury.
empty.readonly: The project team, the supervisor and the innovation manager can request an evaluation.

running.title: The AI is evaluating the project
running.text: It usually takes up to a minute. You can leave the page — the evaluation is saved and appears in the history.

stages.reading: The AI reads the answers to the project's steps
stages.checking: Checking the answer against the rubric

failed.title: The evaluation could not be produced

report.honestyTitle: The evaluation was generated by AI and is a recommendation
report.honestyText: It guides the team; it is not a decision of the jury. Check the conclusions against the project's facts.

override.title: Correct a score
override.description: The new score replaces the AI's score for the criterion and recalculates the total. The AI score and your comment stay in the report.
override.commentHint: Why you change the score — the team will see the comment. At least 10 characters.

rubric.title: Evaluation rubric
rubric.lead: Weights of the criteria the AI uses to evaluate the university's projects. The weights add up to 100.
rubric.sumBad: The weights must add up to 100; now {{value}}.
rubric.note: New weights apply to the next evaluations; earlier ones are not recalculated.
rubric.stale: Another administrator has just changed the rubric — the current version is loaded.
